Name: Gifts from Marlon - Adventurer Gear and Dungeon Supplies
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
Receive a gift by mail at every level of combat you achieve.  

Face monsters and engage in combat without fear, level up and receive items to further enhance your skills.

Rings and potions to strengthen and improve your own play style; each reward will motivate you to conquer the next.

A special challenge awaits you at the maximum level.

Get stronger and see for yourself!
